en.headline: Observatory expects cooler weather as northeast monsoon arrives
en.dek: A cold front will cross the Guangdong coast this morning, bringing rain at first and progressive cooling, with urban lows around 16 degrees on Wednesday and Thursday.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory issued a special weather tip at midnight saying a cold front would move across the coast of Guangdong this morning, with the associated northeast monsoon bringing strong northerly winds and progressive cooling.

There will be a few rain patches, more frequent at first. Temperatures are expected to fall from about 23 degrees at midnight toward 18 degrees in urban areas by tonight, a couple of degrees lower in the New Territories.
On Wednesday and Thursday the weather will be cool in the morning and at night, with urban minimum temperatures around 16 degrees and lower in the New Territories. The public is advised to keep warm.
Under the combined effect of spring tide and the northeast monsoon, coastal water levels may be slightly higher than normal on Wednesday night, and minor flooding is possible in some low-lying areas.

zh.headline: 天文台料東北季候風今早抵達 天氣逐步轉涼
zh.dek: 冷鋒今早橫過廣東沿岸，初時有幾陣雨，天氣轉涼，周三周四市區最低約16度。
body: 香港天文台於午夜發出特別天氣提示，指一道冷鋒會在今早橫過廣東沿岸，隨後的東北季候風令本港轉吹偏北強風，天氣逐步轉涼。
今日有幾陣雨，初時較為頻密。氣溫由午夜約23度，逐步下降至晚上市區最低約18度，新界再低一兩度。
星期三及星期四早晚清涼，市區最低氣溫在16度左右，新界再低兩三度。市民請留意天氣變化，注意保暖。
受天文大潮及東北季候風共同影響，預料周三晚上沿岸水位較正常稍高，部分低淤地區可能出現輕微水浸。
